content: I took off both sides at the beginning - made so many of the steps much easier to do.

I'm confused. It's recommending to take off the Bowden-guide for convenience, but I don't see where we put the Bowden back on. I have the side panel off, so I can easily reach, but am I supposed to remove this anyways?
Why did we bother reinstalling the Bowden’s guide if we are just removing it here

replies.content:
Since some of us are installing the Gen 2 + INDX upgrades at the same time it can get confusing.

IIRC, the instruction specifically said to remove it and skip the steps in the Gen 2 conversion where they ask to reinstall it.
